author: Play On Tabletop
description:
This episode is brought to you by https://frontlinegaming.org/ your one stop shoph for all your tabletop gaming needs in North America! 

Now you can get support from one of the most trusted names in tabletop gaming through their new Tournament Support Program! Whether you're hosting a local RTT or a massive convention Frontline Gaming and their sponsors want to help your players walk away with something awesome! With FLG's Tournament Support Program you can really make your next event something to remember! https://events.frontlinegaming.org/TOSupport


The Great Game continues on as Khorne and Tzeentch pit their champions against each other in this battle of Primarchs! Jordan brings a deadly duo of Angron and Skarbrand to shed blood and claim skulls for the glory of Khorne while Mubin brings Magnus in an effort to plot, scheme and manipulate the winds of the warp to victory. Will Angron continue to be blessed by Khorne or will Magnus and his Tzeentchian trickery prevail?  

========
title: Magnus vs Angron! Thousand Sons vs World Eaters Warhammer 40k in 40m
